details.about: Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform used by millions of companies, from startups to the world's largest enterprises, to accept payments and grow revenue. This engineering role works on infrastructure: scalable, reliable and efficient systems in the public cloud that power Stripe's global, high-availability financial services. Multiple positions are available.
duties: Contribute to the team's strategy, roadmap, tooling, processes and culture
Scope, design, implement and deploy robust solutions
Balance trade-offs between reliability, throughput, latency, resiliency, engineering velocity and cost
Design and build software that improves infrastructure, resiliency, reliability and efficiency at scale
Uphold high engineering standards and improve the codebase and processes
needs: Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science or a related field, plus 2 years of software development experience
2 years designing and deploying scalable infrastructure on AWS, Azure or GCP
2 years with cloud-native networking, compute (EC2) and storage for global, high-availability financial services
2 years developing distributed systems and internal tooling in Go and Ruby
2 years writing maintainable code to automate infrastructure and build core microservices
2 years with Kubernetes and containers for large server fleets and microservices
2 years designing orchestration for reliability, resource efficiency and seamless deployments
2 years designing, building and debugging high-scale distributed systems with open-source tools, finding bottlenecks and improving latency, resiliency and cost
details.benefits: Base salary $156,800 – $235,200 a year; any sales commissions or bonuses would be on top. Additional benefits may include equity, a company bonus, a 401(k) plan, medical, dental and vision benefits and wellness stipends.

scenes.head: About Stripe
bullets: Financial infrastructure for millions of businesses
From startups to the largest enterprises
lines: Stripe builds the financial infrastructure that millions of businesses, from startups to the world's largest companies, use to take payments and grow online.
This team keeps that infrastructure fast, reliable, and efficient at global scale.

scenes.head: What you'll do
lines: You'll help shape your team's strategy, roadmap, tools, and culture.
You'll scope, design, build, and deploy robust solutions.
You'll weigh trade-offs between reliability, throughput, latency, resilience, engineering speed, and cost.
And you'll build software that makes infrastructure more reliable and efficient at scale, while keeping the engineering bar high.

You also need two years in each of these: designing and deploying scalable infrastructure on A W S, Azure, or Google Cloud, plus cloud networking, compute, and storage for high-availability financial services.
Two years building distributed systems and internal tools in Go and Ruby, and automating infrastructure with clean, maintainable code.
And two years with Kubernetes and containers at large scale, designing orchestration for reliable deployments, and debugging high-scale distributed systems with open-source tools.
